title: CSRF on account email-change endpoint
description: The POST /account/email endpoint changes the account email but does not validate any CSRF token or check the Origin/Referer header. A malicious page can submit a cross-site form that changes a logged-in user's email, enabling account takeover through password reset. The update_email view in accounts/views.py has the framework's CSRF protection disabled for this route.
poc_text: Host an auto-submitting form POSTing to /account/email with the attacker's address; a logged-in victim who visits it has their email changed.
